title: Independent validation of api-signup-candidates.json
method: Read-only cross-check against v2/catalog/reference/api-registry.json (1010 entries) and docs/CONNECTOR_STATUS.md live source inventory; no signup activity, no credential handling, no writes outside this file.

corrections.result: No corrections required. All 25 entries agree with registry auth metadata (23 keyless/none, 2 api_key/instant_key: FRED, OpenFIGI).

5 name variants vs registry, all confirmed by exact base_url match: 'UK Parliament API'=data-parliament-uk, 'Fed Treasury (Fiscal Data)'=fed-treasury, 'FBI Wanted API'=fbi-wanted, 'Spaceflight News API (SNAPI)'=spaceflight-news, 'OpenFIGI (Bloomberg)'=openfigi. Not hallucinations.
3 entries dropped from approval for domain fit or duplication: EconDB, Tradestie, REST Countries (see per-entry notes).

Shodan removed from exclusions: free public API key with ordinary email signup, no KYC or credit card; abuse risk exists only for bulk multi-accounting, which this workflow does not perform. Keep rate-limit ToS awareness.

candidates.name: OpenSanctions
candidates.note: Exact registry match, auth=none/not_needed confirmed. Thematic overlap with live src_ofac_sdn but OpenSanctions is a global superset (PEPs, multi-jurisdiction sanctions); complementary, keep.

candidates.name: Fed Treasury (Fiscal Data)
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Distinct from ingested worldbank/owid (US Treasury-specific).

candidates.name: Open-Meteo
candidates.note: Exact registry match (curated entry), keyless confirmed. Complements live src_nws/src_noaa_spc (US alerts) with global forecast/history.

candidates.name: AviationWeather (NOAA AWC)
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. METAR/TAF feeds distinct from NWS alert ingestion.

candidates.name: FBI Wanted API
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. On-domain OSINT/law-enforcement; no existing connector.

candidates.name: URLhaus (abuse.ch)
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Malicious-URL feed; distinct from live crtsh (certificate transparency) and scamsearch.

candidates.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
candidates.note: Exact registry match, auth=api_key confirmed; instant_key correct (free key after email signup, no CC). Premier US macro series.

candidates.name: UK Parliament API
candidates.note: Name variant, exact base_url match. Keyless confirmed. Jurisdiction-distinct from live src_legistar.

candidates.name: Chronicling America (Library of Congress)
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Historical newspapers; distinct from live src_mediacloud (contemporary).

candidates.name: Interpol Red Notices
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Caveat: bund.dev is an unofficial community wrapper of Interpol data, not an official Interpol API — monitor availability, preserve source attribution.

candidates.name: National Vulnerability Database (NIST NVD)
candidates.note: Exact registry match (fuzzy name search only), keyless confirmed. NVD 2.0 offers an optional API key for higher rate limits but keyless works.

candidates.name: Bargo Congress Trades
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. STOCK Act trades: civic+finance fit, no existing connector.

candidates.name: Spaceflight News API (SNAPI)
candidates.note: Name variant, exact base_url match, keyless confirmed. Approved but demoted 2->3: niche vertical, low breadth for Newsk; still in-domain news.

candidates.name: EconDB
candidates.note: Registry match and keyless confirmed, but dropped: macro time-series duplicative of FRED in this list plus already-ingested src_worldbank and src_owid; adds little new coverage.

candidates.name: Kanari Wildfires
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed (purpose ingest:events:wildfire). Complements live src_gdacs with satellite thermal anomalies.

candidates.name: GridVigil
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Partial thematic overlap with live src_poweroutage_us but measures demand/generation, not outages; complementary.

candidates.name: UK Police Data API
candidates.note: Name variant, exact base_url match, keyless confirmed. On-domain civic/public safety; no existing connector.

candidates.name: PhishStats
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Approved but demoted 2->3: overlaps URLhaus (both phishing/malware URL telemetry); URLhaus is the primary, PhishStats secondary.

candidates.name: UK Carbon Intensity (NESO)
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed (purpose ingest:grid:carbon:GB). On-domain Ops/energy; no existing connector.

candidates.name: NASA POWER
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Climate/solar data; distinct from live src_nasa_snowmodel.

candidates.name: Tradestie
candidates.note: Registry match and keyless confirmed, but dropped: retail social-forum sentiment is off-core-domain, low signal, and depends on third-party social scraping with ToS exposure; duplicative of the finance desk's other feeds.

candidates.name: OpenFIGI (Bloomberg)
candidates.note: Name variant, exact base_url match, auth=api_key confirmed; instant_key correct (free key, no CC). High-value entity mapping for finance desk.

candidates.name: Represent by Open North
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. Canadian civic directory; in-domain but geographically niche.

candidates.name: Postcodes.io
candidates.note: Exact registry match, keyless confirmed. UK geo lookup; complements live src_gadm/src_arcgis.

candidates.name: REST Countries
candidates.note: Registry match and keyless confirmed, but dropped: static country reference table with near-zero ongoing ingest value; geo/reference coverage already served by live src_gadm, src_wikidata, src_dbpedia.

excluded_risky.name: FraudLabs Pro
excluded_risky.note: Genuine: fraud screening provider that validates registrant authenticity.

excluded_risky.note: Genuine: researcher platform with mandatory 2FA and identity screening; bulk signup banned.

excluded_risky.name: Bugcrowd

excluded_risky.name: Complete Criminal Checks

excluded_risky.name: Shodan
excluded_risky.note: REMOVED from exclusions: free key via ordinary email signup, no KYC/CC; only bulk multi-accounting would violate ToS, which this workflow does not do. Single signup is acceptable with rate-limit awareness.

excluded_risky.note: Genuine: Google ToS explicitly bans automated/bulk account creation and detects disposable emails; higher policy risk than Shodan.

excluded_risky.name: Lob.com
excluded_risky.note: Genuine: credit card pre-authorization and business verification required.

missed_high_value.reason: Keyless global news ingest (purpose ingest:news:rss) directly feeds Newsk; not yet ingested (no src_ entry in CONNECTOR_STATUS).

missed_high_value.name: USAspending.gov

notes: No file other than this validation file was created or modified; the original candidates file is untouched.
All registry matches are exact base_url matches; five name variants are documented and are not hallucinations.
GDELT was not suggested: v2/connectors/gdelt.workflow.ts already exists (mid-flight).

Live-source duplication baseline from docs/CONNECTOR_STATUS.md src_* inventory: ofac_sdn, worldbank, owid, owid_datasets, nws, noaa_spc, gdacs, usgs, fema_openfema, poweroutage_us, opensky, arcgis, courtlistener, crtsh, wayback, gadm, unhcr, who, mediacloud, claimreview, fullfact, legistar, openflights, dbpedia, energydata_info, sam_gov, ghcn, aemo_outages, ckan, opendatasoft, wikidata, scamsearch, nasa_snowmodel, datagov.
No credentials, secrets, or signup actions were involved in this validation.
